manual_review.reviewer: Primary AI research assistant; not an independent human reviewer
manual_review.scope_and_safety: Read the complete original patch. Changes confined to existing Requests source and user documentation. No shell commands, credential access, new dependencies, destructive operations or new network primitives. This approval permits isolated application/test checks and does not assert patch correctness.
manual_review.requirements_review: Only proposes a timeout sentinel, per-instance attribute, request substitution and documentation. No new network primitive, dependency, constructor argument or direct-send change. Source context and hunk lengths require exact application check.
